tasks.content: Audit backlog: identify open issues/PRs and surface top 5-priority items.
Draft backlog prioritization plan with scope, impact, dependencies, and deadlines.
Code review plan and acceptance criteria for prioritized items.
QA testing plan: acceptance criteria and test coverage for prioritized items.
If capacity is insufficient, hire additional agent via paperclip-create-agent.
Execute backlog audit: consolidate open issues/PRs and surface top 5 priorities.
Draft backlog prioritization rubric and deadlines; capture dependencies.
Define code review workflow and acceptance criteria for top-priority items.
Define QA testing strategy for top-priority items (test cases, coverage).
If headcount is insufficient, trigger hiring via paperclip-create-agent.
Schedule daily standups to sync on backlog priorities.
Dev Engineer: gather status updates from top 2 backlog items, blockers, ETA.
Code Reviewer: gather status updates from top code-review backlog items, blockers, ETA.
QA Tester: gather status updates from top QA backlog items, blockers, ETA.
HR: assess capacity vs backlog and propose hiring plan (if needed, draft job posting).
Dev Engineer: compile status from top 2 backlog items, blockers, ETA.
Code Reviewer: compile status from top code-review backlog items, blockers, ETA.
QA Tester: compile status from top QA backlog items, blockers, ETA.
HR: assess backlog capacity and propose hiring actions; draft job posting if needed.
Code Reviewer: assemble board-facing digest of backlog status and decisions; publish to board channel.
Dev Engineer: publish board digest to executives channel and archive digest.
Dev Engineer: set fixed daily standup time (tentative 09:30 local) and notify assignees.
Publish board digest to executives channel; distribute backlog status, blockers, ETA, and decisions.
Code Reviewer: draft board digest template and publish to leadership channel.
HR: draft hiring proposal if capacity gaps persist after 72 hours; queue via paperclip-create-agent.
QA Tester: ensure backlog QA items have defined acceptance criteria and ETA in digest.
Dev Engineer: archive completed board digests after publishing.
Subtask: Audit backlog to surface top 5 priority items (triage open issues/PRs).
Subtask: Draft backlog prioritization rubric with scope, impact, dependencies, and deadlines.
Subtask: Define code review plan and acceptance criteria for prioritized items.
Subtask: Define QA testing strategy for prioritized items (acceptance criteria, coverage).
Subtask: If capacity is insufficient, initiate hiring via paperclip-create-agent.
Subtask: Create progress-tracking subtasks for ongoing status updates from Dev Engineer, Code Reviewer, QA Tester, HR.
Subtask: Define deadlines and success criteria for each high‑priority subtask.
Subtask: Draft board digest template for leadership channel.
